fichas.title: Ventilation systems in animal housing
fichas.summary: Overview of convection and forced ventilation, including shaft, eaves-ridge, pressurised, extract and balanced-pressure systems. The page gives operating conditions and energy requirements, illustrates fan types and an earth-filter system, and describes sizing air openings using printed formulas and variables.
uses: Managing indoor air movement and air quality

fichas.title: Air temperature and relative humidity for animals
fichas.summary: A reference table lists optimal air-temperature ranges and relative humidity for animal groups, as well as recommended calculated winter values. The footnote says that as animals age, temperature should gradually decrease from the higher to the lower value; asterisks appear on several printed ranges.
uses: Setting animal-house temperatures and relative humidity
Planning zone heating for young animals
